limits: One macOS arm64 host; no affinity/frequency control or universal optimum. Retain each cohort and every adverse p95.
Parser includes the shared measurement allocator forwarding wrapper and complete owned output/FNV. CLI uses the ordinary allocator and includes spawn, traversal, reads, pipe transport and exit.
cold_ns is the first retained call, after correctness setup; it is not a cold filesystem or uninitialized parser claim.
Requested allocation counts/bytes are separate instrumented passes, not live or peak bytes. Distinct-child time -l observations measure actual macOS peak RSS; their timings are excluded.
Finite lexical source inventory only. Macro/cfg/compiler exports, arbitrary hostile syntax depth and concurrently mutated trees are not established.
Earlier before/after attribute-only and failed attempts remain retained; they are not substituted for these balanced matched-input cohorts.
